$env:UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT='private-input/4b06809c9ca2d51ba83b'

$env:OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='4'
$env:OMP_NUM_THREADS='4'
$env:POLARS_MAX_THREADS='4'

$env:PYTHONPATH += ';private-input/f0b09867706f786297b8;private-input/e5ce4022c3bb83280dee'
$env:PYTHONIOENCODING='utf-8'
uv run --offline --frozen --no-sync python -B -c @'
import json
from pathlib import Path
from artifacts.rp4_v4_code.report_v4_checked import read_json, read_csv, verify_receipt_identity, verify_results
from artifacts.rp4_code.evaluate import sha256
folder=Path("artifacts/rp4_v4_b3_rv5")
receipt=read_json(folder/"receipt.json")
verify_receipt_identity(receipt,5,"confirmation")
assert receipt["exit_code"]==0
assert all(c["exit_code"]==0 and sha256(Path(c["log"]))==c["log_sha256"] for c in receipt["commands"])
assert all(sha256(Path(k))==v for k,v in receipt["artifacts_sha256"].items())
summary=read_json(folder/"summary.json")
verify_results(summary,read_csv(folder/"session_losses.csv"),5,"confirmation")
original=read_json(Path("artifacts/rp4_v3_b3/summary.json"))
assert (summary["N_sessions"],summary["N_origins"])==(original["N_sessions"],original["N_origins"])==(25,9750)
assert summary["executed_origins_by_asset"]==original["executed_origins_by_asset"]
print(json.dumps({"status":"VERIFIED","horizon":5,"window":"confirmation","N_sessions":summary["N_sessions"],"N_origins":summary["N_origins"],"v3_asset_count_parity":True,"commands_verified":len(receipt["commands"]),"receipt_sha256":sha256(folder/"receipt.json"),"summary_sha256":sha256(folder/"summary.json"),"losses_sha256":sha256(folder/"session_losses.csv"),"contrasts":summary["contrasts"]},sort_keys=True))
'@
exit $LASTEXITCODE
